articles.summary: Union Pacific has a goal of zero crossing incidents - because even one is too many. But people continue to use railroad property as a short cut, or they make bad decisions at crossings.

articles.summary: Built in the 1880s as an industrial town for the Pullman Company, the historic district highlights both the promise of American opportunity and the struggles for civil rights and fair labor standards.
articles.title: Pullman History Honored with National Monument

articles.summary: Railroads and oil companies stage a show-and-tell in Sacramento to highlight safety measures they've put in place. Environmentalists and community activists remain skeptical.
articles.title: Railroads, Big Oil Move to Ease Fears Over Crude Shipments

articles.summary: Two of California's biggest railroads showed off their latest safety and training equipment in Sacramento on Tuesday and said they are ready for an oil train accident.
articles.title: Railroads Promote Their Readiness for Oil Train Accidents

articles.summary: The Feb. 24 event brought together safety experts, railroad officials and oil and chemical industry representatives to discuss rail safety and emergency response programs associated with moving crude oil by rail.
articles.title: California Agencies Get an Inside View of Rail Safety
